player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone jàngoro {player_id} ci **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Bindal sa tànk ci **[macro  micro]** (ñaari lim 0-8):
• *macro*  = bu nu ngone ci mini-po ci ngay wacci
• *micro* = bu nu ngone ci róobu koko ci mini-po
Seetu `[7 8]` ➜ wacci sa mark ci mini-po 7, róobu 8, te
war ci sa noonam ngay wacci ci mini-po 8 ci ginaaw.

Yaa ngone `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jëf bi war na nekk ci form [macro micro] ak lim yi 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Jëfandikukat bi nekk war na diggante 0 ak 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Micro_board, row walla col nekkul ci range.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Jëfandikukat bi war na nekk ci xët wu topp.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Jëfandikukat bi ñu ko jël na.

next_board.any: ay micro-board yu nekk ci suuf si.

game_action.played: Jàngoro {player_id} jàpp ci bu nu ngone jàngoro waññi {macro_idx}, waññi {micro_idx} (rëw {row}, kolon {col}). Jàngoro {opponent_id} jàpp na koo xam ci {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Jëfandikukat {player_id} moo ci jël ab tukki bu mujj.
